name: Condemned to Rot
body:
School necromancy [curse, disease, evil]; Level cleric/oracle 6, death mage 6, lathspell 4, shaman 6, sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 6

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target living creature touched
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You infect the target with a cursed disease of wasting.

The target is not able to be healed by magical means and loses any natural healing, including fast healing or regeneration. Heal skill checks do not help.

Additionally, if they have any damage, they additionally must make a Fortitude save each time they rest overnight or take damage equal to their hit dice.
